name: DevnDespro SafeDelete
author: devndespro

sections.description:
DevnDespro SafeDelete helps you understand which content may be affected before deleting a WordPress page.

When you move a page to Trash, SafeDelete checks other posts and pages for direct links to that page. It shows the results in a review window so you can make a more informed decision.

Features include:

  • Review references before moving a page to Trash.
  • Check multiple selected pages before bulk deletion.
  • See which posts and pages contain direct links to the selected page.
  • View risk levels based on the number of references found.
  • Open referencing content for review.
  • Cancel deletion without changing your content.

SafeDelete currently checks direct permalink matches in WordPress post content. It does not detect every type of link or dependency.

SafeDelete Pro

Need deeper reference checks before deleting WordPress pages?

DevnDespro SafeDelete Pro extends the Free plugin with:

  • Elementor reference detection.
  • Classic menu and navigation reference detection.
  • Supported custom field reference detection.
  • A dedicated reference scanning dashboard.
  • Searchable reference results and detailed reporting.

SafeDelete Pro works alongside SafeDelete Free. The Free plugin continues to handle Trash confirmation.

SafeDelete Pro is available for $5 as a one-time purchase.

Learn more about SafeDelete Pro: View SafeDelete Pro

Note: Reference scans have limits and may not detect every dependency.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP through Plugins > Add New Plugin > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate DevnDespro SafeDelete.
  3. Open Pages > All Pages.
  4. Select Trash on a page, or use the bulk Move to Trash action.
  5. Review the results before confirming.
sections.faq:
Does SafeDelete delete pages automatically?

No. SafeDelete displays a review window before the normal WordPress Trash action continues.

Does it check bulk deletion?

Yes. You can review selected pages before moving them to Trash.

Does it find every link to a page?

No. The current version checks direct permalink matches in WordPress post and page content.

Can I cancel the deletion?

Yes. You can close the review window without moving the page to Trash.
